title: 第12章 胸口彩绘-《穿越2006小手替被影帝追着宠》
content:
第(1/3)页

    “要我说，还不如试试其他颜料，也许有一款沈老师不过敏呢？”先前那位化妆师还是瞧不上韩小汐。

    “老板又不是试验品——”郭炜回怼。

    “大炜！”沈珩声音冷了几分。

    郭炜瞬间闭嘴。

    “不劳烦几位老师，我们自己想办法。”对上几位化妆师，沈珩的声音恢复了一贯的客气有礼。

    但也仅此而已。

    老板发话，郭炜立马“客气”送客。

    几个化妆师悻悻然离开。

    斯蒂芬还有些发愣，彩绘师都走了，当真要靠这个小可怜。

    “老板？”

    沈珩却看向韩小汐，“能做到吗？”

    深邃的眼神，让韩小汐一瞬间就红了脸。

    与心动无关，单纯的生理性的被吸引，沦陷。

    “我……试试。”她连摇头的勇气都没有。

    “嗯。”沈珩点头，从化妆椅上站了起来，“大炜，清场。”

    “好的，老板。”郭炜应声。

    韩小汐一脸狐疑，这都要清场？

    然而她听到不远处一个小配角问了出来，“大炜哥，那天拍浴桶戏你清场也就算了，今天怎么化个妆也要清场？”

    “给你留下来参观不成？”郭炜笑骂着赶人。

    韩小汐微微愣了一下，原来上次，是他帮她清的场……

    “小汐，怎么画？用什么颜料？”相比于清场，斯蒂芬更在意业务。

    “用眼影盘！”韩小汐已经有了主意。

    “天哪！”斯蒂芬张圆了嘴巴，“你确定？？”

    “嗯。”面对斯蒂芬，韩小汐自信得多。

    她主动和斯蒂芬一起挑合适的眼影盘。

    无意中看到沈珩在脱衣服，手里的动作都停下了。

    “哦！忘了说了，图案画在老板胸口！”

    韩小汐手里的眼影盘差点没拿稳。

    沈珩则是继续慢条斯理地脱衣服，随手丢在了桌上，正好盖在了韩小汐的手账本上。

    ……

    理论成立的事情，实践起来困难重重。

    单是将粉状的眼影调成膏状就费了不少事。

    当时看视频时，韩小汐记得是用甘油，但实际操作起来，粘性不够。

    她又换了无香型润肤露，最后干脆加了一点点发胶。
    第(1/3)页

"If you ask me, you might as well try other paints. Maybe there is one that Teacher Shen is not allergic to?" The makeup artist from before still looked down on Han Xiaoxi.

“The boss is not a test subject——” Guo Wei replied.

"Da Wei!" Shen Heng's voice was a bit colder.

Guo Wei shut up instantly.

"Don't bother the teachers, we will figure it out ourselves." When facing the makeup artists, Shen Heng's voice returned to its usual politeness.

But that’s all.

When the boss spoke, Guo Wei immediately saw off the guests "pleasedly".

Several makeup artists left angrily.

Stephen is still in a daze, the painters are all gone, so he really has to rely on this poor little guy.

"Boss?"

Shen Heng looked at Han Xiaoxi, "Can you do it?"

The deep eyes made Han Xiaoxi blush instantly.

It has nothing to do with heartbeat, it is purely physiological attraction and fall.

"I...try." She didn't even have the courage to shake her head.

"Yes." Shen Heng nodded and stood up from the makeup chair, "Da Wei, clear the place."

"Okay, boss." Guo Wei responded.

Han Xiaoxi looked suspicious. Is the place going to be cleared?

However, she heard a minor supporting actor not far away ask, "Brother Dawei, you just cleared the place for the bathtub scene that day. Why do you have to clear the place even if you put on makeup today?"

“Can’t I stay for you to visit?” Guo Wei laughed and scolded and chased people away.

Han Xiaoxi was slightly stunned. It turned out that he helped her clear the scene last time...

"Xiao tide, how do you paint? What paint do you use?" Compared with clearing the place, Stephen cares more about business.

"Use an eyeshadow palette!" Han Xiaoxi already had an idea.

“Oh my god!” Stephen opened his mouth, “Are you sure??”

"Yeah." Facing Stephen, Han Xiaoxi was much more confident.

She took the initiative to choose a suitable eye shadow palette with Stephen.

I accidentally saw Shen Heng taking off his clothes, and the movements of his hands stopped.

"Oh! I forgot to mention, the pattern is painted on the boss's chest!"

Han Xiaoxi almost lost her grip on the eyeshadow palette in her hand.

Shen Heng continued to take off his clothes slowly and threw it on the table, just covering it on Han Xiaoxi's ledger.

……

What is true in theory is difficult to practice.

It takes a lot of work just to turn powdery eye shadow into paste.

When watching the video, Han Xiaoxi remembered using glycerin, but in actual operation, it was not sticky enough.

She switched to unscented body lotion and finally added a little hairspray.
